summary: Native Rust / Bevy reconstruction now includes original frame policy and tournament scoring, with playable workbench smoke checks. Full minigame gameplay remains unfinished.
details: Original frame policy: 60 ms cap, fixed simulation and pause branches, plus bounded physics slice scheduling.
MultiplayerMode: round points, wins, previous-rank tie resolution, query results and original placement overwrite behavior.
These native ports have bounded original-code evidence. They do not promote the whole GameState::Update or PhysicsManager functions to proven status.
scope: Native reconstruction evidence is tracked separately from the whole-function decompilation and lifter percentages below.
